name: Mini Robot Rover Chassis Kit - 2WD with DC Motors
notes: Two small brushed DC motors rated about 3-6V. Drive them from a motor driver, never straight from Pi GPIO. Give the motors their own battery; share only ground with the Pi.

name: Romi Chassis Kit - Black
notes: Round 165 mm differential-drive base with a built-in 6x AA battery holder. Mini plastic gearmotors included. Use a dual H-bridge driver; motors need their own supply.

name: Pirate - 4WD Mobile Platform
notes: Four DC gearmotors. Wire each side's two motors in parallel so a dual driver (2 channels) can steer it. Four motors stalling can pull several amps: size the driver and motor battery for that. Payload is an estimate; vendor page does not state it clearly.

name: Hiwonder Large Metal 4WD Vehicle Chassis (12V encoder gearmotors)
notes: Aluminium frame with mecanum wheels and 12V motors. 12V motors draw more current than small TT motors: use a high-power driver and a 12V-capable motor battery. Encoder outputs are 5V on some versions; level-shift to 3.3V before the Pi.

name: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B - 4 GB RAM
notes: GPIO is 3.3V logic and NOT 5V tolerant. No analog inputs: use an ADC such as the ADS1115. Needs a steady 5V 3A supply on USB-C or the 5V pins. 26 usable GPIO (BCM 2-27); BCM 2/3 are I2C.

name: Raspberry Pi 5 - 4 GB RAM
notes: GPIO is 3.3V logic and NOT 5V tolerant. No analog inputs. Wants 5V 5A for full USB current; 5V 3A works with reduced USB power. Camera uses the smaller 22-pin CSI connector (needs the right ribbon cable). gpiozero works; RPi.GPIO does not.

name: Adafruit TB6612 1.2A DC/Stepper Motor Driver Breakout
notes: 2 channels, 1.2A each (3A peak). Motor supply VM 4.5-13.5V; logic VCC from the Pi 3.3V pin. Pins: AIN1, AIN2, PWMA, BIN1, BIN2, PWMB, STBY.

name: DRV8833 Dual Motor Driver Carrier
notes: 2 channels, 1.2A continuous each. Motor supply 2.7-10.8V, so not for 12V motors. Pins: AIN1, AIN2, BIN1, BIN2 (PWM on the IN pins).

name: Adafruit DC & Stepper Motor HAT for Raspberry Pi - Mini Kit
notes: 4 DC motor channels over I2C (two TB6612 chips), 1.2A each. Uses only SDA/SCL. Motor power 5-12V on its own terminal block, separate from the Pi.

name: Dual G2 High-Power Motor Driver 24v14 for Raspberry Pi
notes: 2 channels, 14A continuous each, 6.5-30V motor supply. Use for 12V or heavy chassis. Uses fixed GPIO pins for PWM, direction, sleep and fault.

name: Adafruit 16-Channel 12-bit PWM/Servo Driver - I2C [PCA9685]
notes: Drives up to 16 servos over I2C. Servos need their own 5-6V supply on the V+ terminal; never power servos from the Pi 5V rail. Logic VCC 3.3V from the Pi.

name: ADS1115 16-Bit ADC - 4 Channel
notes: Adds analog inputs over I2C (the Pi has none). Power from 3.3V so its I2C lines stay at 3.3V.

name: MeArm Pocket Sized Robot Arm Kit (4 hobby servos)
notes: Fixed servo arm. 4 hobby servos: drive them from a PCA9685 board with a separate 5-6V servo supply. Acrylic, so keep loads light.

name: Waveshare 4-DOF Metal Robot Arm Kit for Raspberry Pi
notes: Fixed servo arm with 4 metal-gear servos. Reach and payload are estimates: vendor page does not list them. Servos need a separate supply (the included HAT has a 5V 3A regulator fed from VIN).

name: Glideforce LACT10P-12V-20 Linear Actuator with Feedback, 10" stroke (vertical lift mast)
notes: Extendable arm: mount vertically as a lift mast, about 356 mm retracted plus 250 mm stroke. 12V DC motor: needs one motor driver channel and a 12V supply. Feedback potentiometer is analog: power it from 3.3V and read the wiper through an ADS1115, not a Pi pin. Reach range assumes a small servo wrist on top (estimate).

name: Glideforce LACT12P-12V-20 Linear Actuator with Feedback, 12" stroke (vertical lift mast)
notes: Extendable arm: mount vertically as a lift mast, about 394 mm retracted plus 300 mm stroke. 12V DC motor: needs one motor driver channel and a 12V supply. Feedback potentiometer is analog: power it from 3.3V and read the wiper through an ADS1115. Reach range assumes a small servo wrist on top (estimate).

name: Generic Linear Actuator with Feedback, 4" stroke, 12V (vertical lift)
notes: Extendable arm: about 210 mm retracted plus 100 mm stroke. 12V DC motor: needs one motor driver channel and a 12V supply. Analog feedback: power the pot from 3.3V and read it via ADS1115.

name: ServoCity Servo-Driven Gripper Kit (Servo Included)
notes: One hobby servo: drive from the PCA9685 with a separate 5-6V supply. Jaw opening is an estimate; vendor page does not list it.

name: Peristaltic Liquid Pump with Silicone Tubing - 5V to 6V DC
notes: DC motor pump: switch it with a motor driver channel or a logic-level MOSFET plus flyback diode, never directly from a GPIO pin. Self-priming, so the tank can sit below the nozzle.

name: Submersible 3V DC Water Pump with 1 Meter Wire
notes: Sits inside the tank. Runs at 2.5-6V. Switch with a motor driver channel or MOSFET plus diode. Not self-priming: keep it under water.

name: Gravity: Digital Peristaltic Pump (PPM Servo Control)
notes: Controlled like a servo, so it runs from a PCA9685 channel. Needs its own 5V supply rated for its motor current.

name: Mini Pan-Tilt Kit - Assembled with Micro Servos
notes: Camera mount with two micro servos. Drive the servos from a PCA9685 with a separate 5V supply.

name: Nalgene 16 oz Wide Mouth Sustain Bottle (about 500 ml water tank)
notes: Water tank. Drill the lid for tubing and keep it above the electronics' level only if the pump is self-priming. Full tank adds about 500 g.

name: Nalgene 32 oz Wide Mouth Sustain Bottle (about 1000 ml water tank)
notes: Water tank. Full tank adds about 1 kg, which small chassis cannot carry.

name: Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3 Standard (12MP autofocus)
notes: Plugs into the CSI connector; uses no GPIO. Pi 5 needs the 22-pin mini CSI cable. Use picamera2, not the old picamera library.

name: Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3 Wide (120 degree)
notes: Wide-angle version for room photos. CSI connector, no GPIO. Pi 5 needs the 22-pin mini CSI cable.

name: Ultrasonic Distance Sensor - 3V or 5V - HC-SR04 compatible [RCWL-1601]
notes: Power it from 3.3V so ECHO is 3.3V and safe for the Pi. Pins: TRIG, ECHO. gpiozero DistanceSensor works.

name: Ultrasonic Distance Sensor - 5V (HC-SR04)
notes: 5V part: ECHO outputs 5V, which can damage the Pi. Add a voltage divider (for example 1k and 2k) on ECHO. Pins: TRIG, ECHO.

name: Pololu Digital Distance Sensor, 5cm
notes: Short-range digital proximity: one output pin goes low when something is within about 5 cm. Works at 2.7-6.5V; power at 3.3V for Pi-safe output.

name: Adafruit MPU-6050 6-DoF Accel and Gyro Sensor
notes: I2C on the shared SDA/SCL bus. Helps the robot hold straight lines and detect tipping.

name: Adafruit 9-DOF Absolute Orientation IMU Fusion Breakout - BNO055
notes: I2C with on-chip sensor fusion (gives heading directly). Known to use I2C clock stretching: on the Pi, lower the I2C baud rate if reads fail.

name: USB Battery Pack for Raspberry Pi - 10000mAh - 2 x 5V outputs
notes: Powers the Pi from USB. 2A max on the best port, which is below the Pi 4 recommended 3A and Pi 5 recommended 5A: expect undervoltage warnings under load. Not for motors.

name: 4 x AA Battery Holder with On/Off Switch
notes: Motor supply for small 3-6V gearmotors. Wh assumes 4 x 2000 mAh NiMH cells (not included). Too low for 12V actuators.

name: Rechargeable NiMH Battery Pack: 7.2 V, 900 mAh, 3x2 AAA Cells
notes: Small motor and servo supply. Needs a NiMH charger. Run the Pi from a separate 5V regulator, not straight from this pack.

name: Rechargeable NiMH Battery Pack: 7.2 V, 2200 mAh, 3x2 AA Cells
notes: Main battery for medium robots. Feed the Pi through a 5V step-down regulator. 7.2V is too low to run 12V actuators at full speed.

name: 5V, 3.2A Step-Down Voltage Regulator D36V28F5
notes: Steps a 6-50V battery down to 5V for the Pi's 5V pins. Enough for a Pi 4; marginal for a Pi 5 with USB devices.

name: 5V, 5A Step-Down Voltage Regulator D24V50F5
notes: Steps a 6-38V battery down to 5V at up to 5A. Good for a Pi 5, or a Pi plus servos on a shared 5V rail.

name: Progressive Automations PA-14P Feedback Linear Actuator, 24" stroke, 35 lb, 12V (tall lift mast)
notes: Extendable arm: mount vertically as a lift mast. Vendor table: 29.51" (750 mm) retracted, 53.51" (1359 mm) extended, 3.75 lb, 2.0"/s no load, 1 A no load / 5 A full load, 25% duty cycle. 12V DC motor: needs a 12V supply and one motor driver channel rated 5 A or more (the TB6612 and DRV8833 are too small; use the Dual G2). Built-in potentiometer feedback is analog: power it from 3.3V and read the wiper through an ADS1115. A 750 mm mast on a small chassis tips easily: use the large 4WD chassis, mount it low and centred, and move slowly when extended. Payload 2500 g is an estimate limited by tipping and rod side-load, not the 35 lb motor force. Reach range assumes a small servo wrist on top (estimate).

name: Progressive Automations PA-09-HALL Feedback Mini Industrial Actuator, 18" stroke, 330 lb, 12V (heavy lift mast)
notes: Extendable arm: mount vertically as a lift mast. Vendor table: 23.75" (603 mm) retracted, 41.75" (1060 mm) extended, 4.2 lb, 0.39"/s no load (slow: about 47 s for full stroke), up to 1.5 A no load / 4 A full load at 12V, 25% duty cycle, IP66. 12V DC motor: needs a 12V supply and one motor driver channel rated 4 A or more (use the Dual G2, not the TB6612 or DRV8833). Feedback is a Hall-effect pulse sensor, not a pot: count pulses on 2 GPIO pins, and check the sensor supply voltage on the datasheet; if it outputs 5V pulses, level-shift or use open-collector pull-ups to 3.3V before the Pi. Position is relative, so home it against the retracted limit switch at start. Payload 3000 g is an estimate limited by tipping on a wheeled base, not the 330 lb motor force. Reach range assumes a small servo wrist on top (estimate). Dims l/w are estimates.

name: DFRobot 6 DOF 25KG Digital Servo Desktop Robotic Arm V2 (ROB0036, metal)
notes: Fixed servo arm, 2 mm aluminium, six TD-8125MG servos (about 25 kg-cm each, 500-2500 us PWM). Uses 6 PCA9685 channels. Servos need their own 5-6V supply (vendor lists 4.4-8.4V and more than 2 A); each servo can stall at 2.6-3.4 A, so give the servo rail 10 A or more and never feed it from the Pi. Includes its own gripper (opening not stated). Vendor page lists about 37 cm fully extended but no reach or payload: 300 mm reach, 400 mm lift and 300 g payload are estimates.

name: Hiwonder Full Metal Wave-Edge Robotic Claw with Servo (230 mm max opening)
notes: Wide aluminium claw, one hobby servo: drive it from a PCA9685 channel with a separate 5-6V servo supply. Listing says 230 mm maximum tip opening and 1 lb (about 450 g) max grab weight. The jaws swing in an arc, so the usable grip on a box or bag handle is about 150 mm (estimate). Keep lifted objects under about 450 g even if the arm is stronger. Amazon listing, no datasheet.

name: G6 Robotic Claw Kit, Metal Gripper with DS3120MG 20 kg Servo (20-100 mm grip)
notes: Aluminium claw with a DS3120MG servo (listing: 21.5 kg-cm, 500-2500 us PWM, grips objects 20-100 mm). Drive it from a PCA9685 channel with a separate 5-6V servo supply; a 20 kg servo can stall above 2 A. Mass and dims are estimates (listing gives 1.1 lb shipping weight and about 150 mm width when open). Amazon listing, no datasheet.

name: Nalgene 96 oz Cantene (about 2800 ml collapsible water tank)
notes: Collapsible flat water tank, 241 x 318 mm, 63 mm cap. Lies flat on the deck; strap it down because it sloshes. Drill or adapt the cap for pump tubing. A full tank adds about 2.8 kg, so only the 4WD chassis can carry it; fill it part-way for lighter robots. Filled height (80 mm) is an estimate.

name: Sterilite 16228012 Small Ultra Basket (deck carry bin, 11-1/8 x 8 x 4 in)
notes: Open plastic carry bin for the deck, for items the robot ferries. Bolt or zip-tie it through the weave to the chassis plate. It is longer than small chassis (283 mm), so it overhangs anything but the large 4WD base. No electronics. Mass is an estimate. Load in the bin counts against the chassis payload.

name: goBILDA 12V NiMH Nested Battery, 3000 mAh, XT30, 20A fuse
notes: 12V motor and actuator supply (10 sub-C NiMH cells, 16 AWG, inline 20 A blade fuse). Use it for 12V linear actuators and 12V chassis motors through a driver rated for 12V (Dual G2 or the motor HAT, not the DRV8833). Feed the Pi through a 5V step-down regulator, never directly. Needs a NiMH charger with an XT30 lead. 20 A is the fuse rating, not a datasheet discharge rating. Dims are an estimate.

name: goBILDA 6V NiMH Battery, 3000 mAh, XT30, 20A fuse (servo supply)
notes: Dedicated servo supply: wire it to the PCA9685 V+ terminal (6V suits metal-gear servos) and share only ground with the Pi. Good for big servo arms whose servos stall at 2-3 A each. Too low for 12V actuators. Needs a NiMH charger. Mass and dims are estimates; 20 A is the fuse rating.
